item.title: Whiskers 0.8.68
item.description:
What's new in 0.8.68

### Screen Notes

  • Draw rectangles, ellipses, straight lines, and arrows. Hold Shift for a square, a circle, or a 45° line, and Option to draw a shape from its center.
  • Point at things with the new Laser. It leaves a short fading trail instead of ink, and the note keeps a frame of where you pointed.
  • Ink is now plain red, without a dark outline.
  • Each frame shows the marks drawn for it. Earlier marks still on screen appear faintly, so frames no longer repeat every mark drawn so far.
  • Frames zoom in on what you marked, clicked, or pointed at, so text stays close to its real size. Crop edges avoid cutting through lines of text.
  • Clicks in other apps become frames that show what each click did.
  • Opened menus and popovers now count as screen changes. Longer notes keep more frames, up to 12.
  • The summary describes each mark by shape and position, names the button or item under it, and quotes what you said while drawing it.
  • Cropped frames also keep a whole-screen copy in the note folder.
  • After a note's files expire or are deleted, its History entry appears as a regular transcript.

    • ### Reliability

  • Updated the OpenAI and Deepgram certificate pins to match their current certificates.
  • The focus ring on the selected transcription model card now outlines the card edge.
